rubrics.justification: Generally cautious and mostly consistent with a blastocyst image, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from a single still image and calls it a good-quality day-4 blastocyst/morula-stage embryo despite the image and provided 2AA grade being somewhat discordant.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior failed cycles, semen parameters, BMI, lifestyle, endometrial thickness, and transfer timing into prognosis and management.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and repeated failure/endometriosis; minor issues include some ambiguity around day-4 blastocyst interpretation and protocol-response comments.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice and guideline-based counseling, including caution about morphology limits, luteal support, uterine evaluation, and selective further workup; minor deviations include speculative protocol suggestions and some less-standard adjunct discussions.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycle review/workup, though some recommendations remain broad rather than tightly prioritized for this exact case.
